name: Analyze Query Performance
description: Use performance analysis tools to optimize SQL queries

steps.title: Navigate to Performance Tools
steps.description: Review the various charts and graphs to monitor you database performance.

steps.title: Filter and select workload to Analyze
steps.description: Filter based on timeline to review workload over time (Suggest: Filter time range last 6 hours).

steps.title: Select a query from the Individual Executions tab (Click edit to check the individual executions option)
steps.description: Choose a query from your recent queries (found in Individual Executions tab) to analyze for performance.

steps.title: Run Explain Plan
steps.description: Click 'Explain' or 'Analyze' to generate an execution plan. This shows how the database will execute your query.

steps.title: Review Execution Plan
steps.description: Examine the visual execution plan. Look for table scans, join operations, and index usage. Red or yellow indicators typically show areas for optimization.

steps.title: Check Performance Metrics
steps.description: Review key metrics like estimated cost, rows processed, execution time, and resource usage. Compare these with your performance requirements.

steps.title: Apply Recommendations
steps.description: If the tool provides optimization recommendations (like adding indexes or rewriting queries), review and apply them. Re-run the explain plan to verify improvements.
